thread:
ana: Heads-up — planning a 45-min webinar: 'Lights, Camera, Inference: demoing cost-aware LLM serving' — want a short, punchy live demo + Q&A. Who can run a dry-run this week?

jess: I can do the demo portion. prefer to show 2 model variants (fast/cheap vs high-quality) and the fallback path.

mike: I’ll own the fallback + monitoring slides. can we have an SLO slide with live tracing?

ana: (typo) meant ana :D

ana: updated: want the flow to be intro (5 min), demo + switch variants (20 min), short deep-dive (10), live Q&A (10). keeps it tight.

lee: Sounds good. I'll handle slide transitions and audience prompts. can we get speaker bios + 3 bullets by EOD tomorrow?

sam: I'll be the chat moderator / triage. will pipe top questions to the panel. also will run the audience poll at 30m.

jess: Demo notes: show baseline request -> response time & token cost, then enable prefix caching + quantized variant, show latency/cost delta. fallback test: force capacity throttle to hit failover.

jess: Quick snippet for demo (use as-is in slides):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-fast-qlora","input":"Summarize the paragraph in one sentence."}'
```

jess: then toggle to `redwood-std-8b` and show metrics.

mike: For failover script, I'll add a small traffic-shaper step we can run locally. also setting a synthetic trace to show route switching in Console.

lee: Logistics: rehearsal Fri 10:30 PT (45m). call link: https://zoom.redwood/ai-demo (placeholder). can people confirm?

ana: Confirmed for me. can speakers upload final slide deck to drive by Thu 5pm? also include speaker notes for the demo steps.

jess: Uploaded draft in slides: shortlink https://rwd.md/demo-slides (please review)

sam: I'll test livestream / recording permissions during rehearsal. need everyone to join 10 mins early for A/V check.

mike: Checklist for A/V & fallbacks:
- join 10m early
- mute notifications on test hosts
- test local internet + backup hotspot
- rehearse demo revert (30s)

lee: I'll prep 3 on-screen cues: "Switch model", "Fallback engaged", "Open for Q" — big text so presenters can glance.

ana: Can we do a short lightning prep for openers — 2 bullets each about why cost controls matter. Keeps messaging aligned.

jess: I'll draft those 2 bullets and drop in the doc.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Lights, Camera, Inference — Rehearsal" Fri 10:30 PT. Invitees: ana, jess, mike, lee, sam.

lee: Awesome. Sam & Mike — want you to run a quick post-rehearsal retro in #marketing to capture any blocking issues.

ana: Perfect. If nobody objects, I'll lock in invites and run a 15-min pre-call on Fri to walk through the demo checklist. :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup: all set for me.

jess: good to go. I'll practice the switch so it's <60s.

mike: I'll simulate the failover once in the rehearsal. will log steps to the doc.

ana: Thanks team — huge help. see you Fri.
